about-simple-dynamic.mainStatement: IBS Academy is Kerala's leading professional accounting institute. Our commitment extends beyond the classroom as we strive to uphold the highest standards of professionalism. We equip students with a deep understanding of key accounting concepts through an industry-relevant syllabus, expert guidance, and a proven track record of 100% placement assistance. We are your gateway to success in finance.

testimonials.name: Aspiring CPA
testimonials.text: The US CPA program at IBS Academy provided the expert support and structured learning I needed to pass my exams. The institute truly lives up to its reputation as a gateway to success.

testimonials.name: CMA Graduate
testimonials.text: The Certified Management Accountant course equipped me with a deep understanding of key financial concepts. The industry-relevant syllabus and placement assistance were invaluable.

testimonials.name: Diploma Student
testimonials.text: The Diploma in Financial Accounting & Taxation was the perfect cornerstone for my career. The practical focus and professional standards upheld by the faculty were exceptional.

testimonials.name: Tally Professional
testimonials.text: As a certified Tally professional, I can attest that IBS Academy elevates the accounting profession. The direct certification and continuous practice modules are top-notch.

testimonials.name: Career Changer
testimonials.text: With over 20 years of excellence, IBS Academy's commitment extends beyond the classroom. Their programs are designed for mastery, and the 100% placement assistance gave me confidence.

testimonials.name: Finance Graduate
testimonials.text: Choosing the premier accounting institute in Kerala was the best decision for my financial career. The ISO-certified quality and expert guidance provided a clear path to professionalism.
